description: VOSU generates images, videos and 3D models with leading AI models using the user's existing VOSU account and credits. Users describe what they want and pick a model, animate a photo they upload into a short video, turn an image into a 3D model, and browse, replay or download everything they have generated. Every prompt passes a content-safety check before anything is charged, and the credit balance can be checked before any spend.
